title: Say where end-to-end tests live and how to run them
statement: As a developer, I can write down where our end-to-end tests live and how to run a chosen few, so the catalog and the commands it gives match our real suite.
overview: Proposed addition: this is what lets the catalog and commands work. Deriving membership from the code's location, rather than marking each case, means a case cannot claim to be end to end while its code is elsewhere, and needs no new revision of 182 test cases, which would make their pinned relations stale.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Saga records one or more repository paths that hold end-to-end tests.
A test case is in the catalog when its current test-implementation code is inside those paths, with no field to set on the test case.
A Saga records a command template for running named tests, and the tool never runs it.
Both can be read, changed and removed from the CLI, and a Saga with neither is unaffected.
